Synthetic fixtures only. two-pages.pdf contains “Revenue is 42” and “Costs are 17” on separate pages. mixed-pages.pdf preserves a drawing-only second page; scanned.pdf has drawing-only content, not OCR text. encrypted.pdf uses the non-secret test password synthetic-fixture. corrupt.pdf is intentionally invalid. arabic.docx contains English, Arabic financial text and literal script-tag text to verify escaped display. PDFs were generated with ReportLab and encrypted with pypdf; DOCX was generated with python-docx. No real student data is included. Dependencies are only needed to regenerate fixtures, not run acceptance tests.
